name: intro
arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carrying a gentle Dm - Bb motif with light piano ambient accent tones.

name: verse_1
arrangement: Subtle kick drum on beats 1 and 3, muffled wooden rimshots on 2 and 4, accompanied by a warm melodic bassline moving in quarter notes beneath quiet fingerpicked guitar.

name: pre_1
arrangement: Building tension with swelling warm pad layers, driving eighth-note bass, crescendo on brushed snare, and rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: Full open acoustic guitar strumming, organic live snare with soft ghost notes, melodic bass locking with the kick, and electric guitar playing the two-bar hook melody.

name: turnaround
arrangement: Brief musical breather with lead electric guitar repeating the hook motif over warm acoustic strumming and soft kick/bass groove.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Narrative rhythm continues with kick and rim, bass playing melodic scalar runs, subtle shaker entering on eighth notes to push time forward.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Intensity swells with added acoustic strumming, snare crescendo, rolling bass movement, and rising synth texture.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Vibrant rhythm section with wide open acoustic strumming, active bassline, live snare hits, and prominent hook guitar answering vocal phrases.

name: bridge
arrangement: Arrangement strips back significantly with a pedal point D bass, electric piano introducing harmonic color (Dm9 to Bbmaj7), and muted electric guitar swells.

name: final_chorus
arrangement: Maximum emotional weight with wide stereo acoustics, dynamic live drums, melodic bass counterpoint, and rich vocal harmonies without genre drift.

name: outro
arrangement: Music resolves gently into fingerpicked acoustic guitar and ambient piano decay, ending on a final sustained low D note.
